# Coverage map (generated)

**Generated by `node tools/coverage-map.mjs`. Do not edit by hand.**

Every recorded PRNG call carries a `@ function(file.c:line)` annotation, so
a session's RNG log is a direct sample of which C code ran while it was
recorded. This file aggregates that across the corpus.

Two caveats worth keeping in mind. It only sees code that *draws random
numbers*, so purely deterministic subsystems — most of the tty windowport,
`botl.c`, `objnam.c` — are invisible here despite being where a large share
of the screen output comes from. And it describes the public corpus, which
is early-game heavy; the held-out set will go deeper.

Corpus: **44 sessions**, 11405 steps, 767760 annotated PRNG calls.
